Widia has slashed prices on a targeted spectrum of their ANSI/ISO turning and boring inserts, giving you the opportunity to purchase premium quality tools at a price equal to or below that of the most competitive imports. This group contains a number of inserts for rough to finish turning of steel, cast iron, and stainless steel. Widia Victory inserts are sold in packs of 5, and "All-Star" products are guaranteed to be always available (check the Availability fields).
